scenario.topic: Plan the layout for the community pumpkin patch

options.name: Central Path with Side Planting Beds
options.upside: Clear central pathway allows easy access to all planting beds and seating area.
options.concern: Narrow paths may limit movement when all participants work simultaneously.

options.name: Circular Layout with Radial Paths
options.upside: Radial paths provide multiple access points and visually appealing design.
options.concern: Smaller seating area may reduce comfort during breaks.

options.name: Grid Layout with Evenly Spaced Beds
options.upside: Wide paths and uniform beds support simultaneous work and clear organization.
options.concern: More paths reduce total planting area.

options.name: L-Shaped Layout with Corner Seating
options.upside: Corner seating area offers a quiet rest spot separated from planting beds.
options.concern: Irregular bed shapes may complicate planting and maintenance.

shared_context: The community pumpkin patch layout must accommodate three participants working together, with enough space for planting, pathways, and a small seating area. The design should balance accessibility, aesthetics, and efficient use of the available land.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a community organizer passionate about creating welcoming and functional outdoor spaces.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the seating area is comfortable and separate to encourage relaxation.

A.reason_for: Clear central path allows easy access to all beds and seating.
A.reason_against: Narrow paths may limit movement when working together.

B.reason_for: Radial paths create a visually appealing design.
B.reason_against: Smaller seating area reduces comfort, which conflicts with my goal.

C.reason_for: Wide paths support simultaneous work and clear organization.
C.reason_against: More paths reduce planting area, but seating is adequate.

D.reason_for: Corner seating offers a quiet rest spot separate from planting beds, matching my priority.

personas.background: Liam is a pragmatic gardener focused on efficiency and ease of movement in shared spaces.
personas.private_goal: Maximize planting efficiency while ensuring easy access for all participants.

personas.private_goal: Create a visually appealing layout that encourages community interaction.
